name: Generalizable Semantic Gaussian Splatting
definition: A generalizable semantic Gaussian Splatting method for efficient novel-view synthesis that predicts positions and attributes of scene-adaptive Gaussian distributions from a single input, replacing the densification and pruning processes of traditional scene-specific Gaussian Splatting.
summary: Generalizable Semantic Gaussian Splatting is a feed-forward method that predicts 3D Gaussian parameters for color and semantic rendering directly from multi-view inputs without per-scene optimization.
